SYMPTOM: App tests fail when 'Keyboard Setup' banner or sheet is visible — covers tab bar or intercepts taps
CAUSE: KeyboardSetupView sheet and banner both driven by @AppStorage flags that persist between test runs
FIX PATTERN:
- Banner: tapOn 'keyboard.banner.dismiss' (X button) first in flows that navigate to Settings
- Sheet: if visible, tapOn 'Done' to dismiss before navigating tabs
- After first dismissal, both stay dismissed (AppStorage persists) so subsequent runs skip this
NOTE: 'Keyboard Setup' text appears both in the sheet/banner AND as a Settings section header — don't use runFlow with notVisible on that text as it can match the section header and misfire
APPLIES TO: tab-navigation.yaml, settings.yaml — any flow that goes to Settings tab
